annotations.text:
Inspect mobile v2 — direction
Cream canvas, forest-green primary, sand + gold accents. Libre Baskerville for titles and big numbers, Inter for everything else, JetBrains Mono for ids and hashes. Cards: 1px #E6E0D4 border, 16px radius, whisper shadow. Solar Bold icons for navigation and actions; linear glyphs for content (garment parts are custom drafts).
Tabs: Home · Inspections · Library · Profile. Library is hidden for inspectors (3 tabs, see Home — Inspector).

Loop builder: rows reorder by dragging the handle (react-native-sortables, haptics on lift/drop). Tapping a row opens an edit sheet with Move up / Move down / Remove as the accessible fallback. Hem is shown mid-drag.
Capture-point library: global rows seeded per category + the org's own ("Yours"). Tap to multi-select in the order shots should happen; Custom… creates an org library row and adds it to the loop.
